newsitem.title: USA: SBS Technologies to offer 1.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: SBS Technologies to offer 1.8 mln shares.

text.p: SBS Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has filed to offer 1.8 million shares of the company's common stock.
The company said it would sell 1.58 million of the shares, while the balance -- 220,000 shares -- are to be sold by shareholders.

The company's net proceeds are to be used primarily to pay for the acquisition of Bit 3 Computer Corp, a manufacturer of computer networking and interconnection hardware, and to pay down its long-term debt.
In addition, the company said certain shareholders have granted the underwriters an option to buy up to an additional 270,000 shares to cover any over-allotments.
SBS Technologies said it would not receive any net proceeds from the sale of any shares by stockholders.
